label: Direct lithium extraction
description: Sorbents or membranes recover lithium from brine without evaporation ponds.
note: Type -> reference (node alignment review 2026-11-05 MN07, 2026-11-05): brine lithium needs no mining or milling and makes t LCE, not concentrate; no lithium-brine node, so a reference archetype.

label: Molecular-sieve dehydration
description: Adsorbent beds regenerated with hot gas, to cryogenic-plant dryness.
note: PRODUCT UNIT 1000-m3 (a thousand cubic metres; the regulators print it as e3m3; user 2026-10-23). Node alignment 2026-11-05 (NG02, rule 1): regeneration heat is bought from the gas-processing fired-heater service (direct-heat) as `heat` (the judgements in records/fill/fill-judgement.csv).

label: Pressure-swing adsorption CO2 capture
description: Adsorbent beds separating CO2 from hydrogen-plant syngas.
note: Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Air separation unit
description: Distils liquefied air into oxygen, nitrogen and argon at large scale.

note: Merged air-separation-unit_membrane (Membrane separation) 2026-10-02 [C22, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type conventional, trl 9, product-unit GJ. product-unit t of oxygen, not GJ: the examples are per t or Nm3 of O2 and CIMS requests oxygen in tonnes (corrected 2026-10-02)

label: Anaerobic digester (component)
description: Digests manure, crop residues or organic waste to raw biogas.
note: A component: priced only to assemble whole-plant costs with an upgrader (anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading) or an engine (anaerobic-digester_chp) from the same source. Serves no hierarchy node. Added 2026-09-24.

label: Anaerobic digestion with upgrading
description: Digests organic feed to biogas and upgrades it to pipeline-quality gas.
examples-named: RNG plants on landfills and digesters

label: Anaerobic digestion with engine CHP (whole plant)
description: A digester and a biogas engine generating power, with the engine heat recovered as hot water or low-pressure steam.
note: Whole-plant archetype: the alternative to the anaerobic-digester component plus reciprocating-engine_chp. Its input flow is the organic feedstock, never purchased biogas, since the digester is inside its cost. Electricity is an output flow. Added 2026-09-24.

label: Anaerobic treatment with biogas recovery
description: Anaerobic reactors on high-strength streams, cutting aeration load and recovering biogas as fuel.
note: Turns part of the treatment load into a fuel, which is why it is a technology choice rather than generic pumping. Product unit GJ -> m3 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Batch (bell) annealing
description: Coils annealed under a hood in a protective atmosphere over long cycles.

label: Continuous annealing line
description: Strip annealed in line at high speed rather than in batches.

label: Bell annealing in a hydrogen atmosphere
description: 100% hydrogen atmosphere improves heat transfer and shortens the cycle.
note: Type efficient variant -> alternative (Brad 2026-11-06, efficiency-variant ratio test): a different technology from its host, not an efficiency step on it, so it keeps its own absolute values.

label: Autothermal reforming ammonia plant
description: An ammonia plant whose syngas comes from an oxygen- or air-blown autothermal reformer (with or without a heat-exchange reformer) in place of a fired primary reformer.
note: added 2026-10-05 (archetype combination review 2026-10-03)

label: Autothermal reforming ammonia plant with capture
description: An autothermal-reforming ammonia plant that sends its process CO2, in one concentrated stream, to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: added 2026-10-05 (archetype combination review 2026-10-03)

label: Autothermal reformer (hydrogen)
description: Partial oxidation with oxygen in one vessel; suits high capture rates.
examples-named: Air Products Alberta net-zero hydrogen complex (Edmonton)

Renamed from autothermal-reformer 2026-10-09 (modeller): parallel archetypes both carry a discriminator; a bare name is kept for a base with variants.

label: Autothermal reforming to hydrogen with full capture
description: An oxygen-blown autothermal reformer designed to send nearly all its CO2, in one concentrated stream, to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: The oxygen-blown route gives one concentrated stream, held on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated; there is no dilute flue gas to treat separately. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. Renamed from autothermal-reformer_ccs-concentrated 2026-10-09 (modeller): parallel archetypes both carry a discriminator; a bare name is kept for a base with variants.

label: Basic oxygen furnace
description: Blows oxygen through hot metal to burn out carbon; scrap is the coolant.

label: Basic oxygen furnace efficiency measures, strong
description: Recovering the converter gas and its sensible heat instead of flaring it.
examples-named: converter gas collection and use; sensible heat recovery on the off-gas hood; variable-speed drives on fan motors; improved gas cleaning; lining and ladle management
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. Absorbed basic-oxygen-furnace_efficiency-moderate (MT03, 2026-10-05).

label: Alkali-activated binder
description: Geopolymer binder from slag or ash with an alkali activator, without clinker.
note: Recipe binder (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): asks the ground-slag node for 0.85 t per t; UKERC's E-crete whole-plant capital and fixed O&M are ruled out as another framing and stay in example-parameter.csv

label: Blended cement with supplementary cementitious materials
description: Replaces clinker with slag, fly ash or ground limestone.
note: Recipe binder (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): its clinker, finish grinding and supplementary materials are service requests (records/reference/service-request.csv)

label: Calcined clay cement (LC3)
description: Clay calcined at about 800 degC replaces part of the clinker.
note: CARRIERS (user 2026-10-14, D21, MC008): clay calcination fuel taken as natural gas, as a Canadian flash calciner would burn; grinding on electricity.; Recipe binder (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): its clinker, finish grinding and supplementary materials are service requests (records/reference/service-request.csv)

label: Carbonated binder
description: Calcium silicate binder cured with CO2 rather than water.
note: Self-contained binder plant (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): makes its own clinker or binder and grinds it, so it asks for no clinker and no finish grinding

label: Electrochemical cement from calcium silicates
description: Electrolysis at ambient temperature extracts calcium from non-carbonate calcium silicates and makes a cementitious binder without a kiln, so there is no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Sublime Systems route (MIT spin-out of Ellis et al. 2019); the IEA guide row on electrolytic limestone decarbonation ahead of a kiln is a different route and is not mapped here. Added 2026-09-26.; Self-contained binder plant (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): makes its own clinker or binder and grinds it, so it asks for no clinker and no finish grinding

label: Hydrothermal calcium hydrosilicate binder
description: Binder made in an autoclave and ground, with no rotary kiln (e.g. Celitement).
note: Rests on one source value. Added 2026-09-25.; Self-contained binder plant (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): it asks the clinker node for its 0.18 t clinker per t, and for no finish grinding

label: Portland cement (GU, Type 10)
description: General-use portland cement: clinker with about 5% gypsum and up to 5% limestone (CSA A3001 GU); the binder the blends compete with.
note: Added 2026-10-23 (baselines 2026-10-23 (modeller: build the missing baselines)). Since about 2020 most Canadian output is portland-limestone (GUL), held on binder_blended-cement.; Recipe binder (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): its clinker, finish grinding and supplementary materials are service requests (records/reference/service-request.csv)

label: Calcium sulphoaluminate clinker
description: Clinker based on ye'elimite, fired at about 1250 degC with less limestone.
note: Process CO2 20-50% below Portland clinker. Added 2026-09-25.; Self-contained binder plant (IM03, Brad 2026-11-05): makes its own clinker or binder and grinds it, so it asks for no clinker and no finish grinding

label: Blast furnace
description: Coke-based counter-current shaft reducing iron ore to hot metal, with hot stoves.
examples-named: Stelco Lake Erie; ArcelorMittal Dofasco BF2 and BF4 (retirement scheduled 2030)

label: Blast furnace with biocarbon injection or bio-coke
trl-basis: assessed: charcoal-only mini blast furnaces are commercial in Brazil; partial biocarbon injection (bio-PCI) and bio-coke in large furnaces at trial scale
description: The host blast furnace with part of its injected coal or coke replaced by charcoal or other biocarbon.
examples-named: Acesita charcoal blast furnaces (Brazil); CanmetENERGY biocarbon injection trials
note: Added 2026-11-04 (user, to-process intake NEW proposal). Variant of blast-furnace (modifier biogenic-carbon, as electric-arc-furnace_smelting-submerged-arc_biogenic-carbon). Takes in the earlier blast-furnace_charcoal (ietd_2013_001, 2026-10-07) and blast-furnace_charcoal-injection (gielen_2002_001) proposals.

label: Blast furnace with post-combustion capture
carriers: by-product-gas; hydrogen; coke; coal; electricity; steam
description: A blast furnace whose gas, or the flue gas of the stoves and power plant that burn it, is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Blast-furnace gas is about a fifth CO2, so this is the dilute plant on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Top-gas recycling concentrates the stream instead and is its own row. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Blast furnace efficiency measures, moderate
description: Incremental measures on an existing blast furnace, each worth a few per cent of fuel.
examples-named: top-pressure recovery turbine; improved burden distribution; higher pulverized coal injection; dry gas cleaning
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Blast furnace efficiency measures, strong
description: Heat recovery off the stoves and the slag, the measures the roster separates as the strong bucket.
examples-named: hot stove waste-heat recovery; slag heat recovery; top-gas heat recovery
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Top-gas recycling oxygen blast furnace
description: Oxygen blast with CO2 stripped from the recycled top gas, which also concentrates the CO2.
note: Recycling concentrates the top gas, so capture sits on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated rather than the dilute plant a conventional blast furnace needs.

label: Electric boiler
description: Resistance or electrode boiler raising hot water or steam at about 99% efficiency.
note: Merged boiler_electric-injection-steam (Electric steam generation) 2026-09-23; it had family oil-and-gas, type prospective, trl 7, product-unit m3.

label: Fuel-fired boiler or thermal-oil heater
carriers: natural-gas; oil; by-product-gas; hydrogen; ammonia; biomethane
description: Fire-tube or water-tube boiler raising hot water or steam, or a fired heater circulating thermal oil at 200-400 degC.
note: Merged direct-heater_thermal-oil (Thermal-oil heater) 2026-09-30; it had type conventional, trl 9.

label: Boiler with post-combustion capture
carriers: biomass; natural-gas; coal; nuclear; by-product-gas; oil; biogas; electricity; steam
description: A boiler whose flue gas is sent to capture. Regeneration steam is drawn from the unit itself, a host-side penalty that belongs here. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: [heat-low-temp] Flue gas is dilute, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse and its cost and energy are not repeated here. The steam taken for regeneration is the host-side penalty and belongs on this row. Biomass firing makes it a removal. [heat-medium-temp] Flue gas is dilute, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse and its cost and energy are not repeated here. Regeneration steam at 120-150 degC competes with the medium-temperature duties this band serves. Merged combined-cycle_ccs-diffuse (CHP with post-combustion capture) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 8. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. CHP with capture split out to combustion-turbine_chp_ccs-diffuse 2026-10-07 (modeller). Renamed from boiler_ccs-diffuse 2026-10-08 so the name carries its base archetype.

label: Efficient fuel-fired boiler
carriers: natural-gas; oil; by-product-gas; hydrogen; ammonia; biomethane
description: The fuel-fired boiler with efficiency measures applied, including condensing operation where the return water is cold enough.
examples-named: boiler improvement to 80% and to 85% efficiency (UKERC ST-B1, ST-B2)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on boiler_fuel-fired. Merged boiler_condensing (Condensing boiler) 2026-09-30; it had type efficient variant, trl 9.

label: Oxy-fuel boiler
description: Boiler fired on oxygen (from an air separation unit or an oxygen-conducting membrane) and recycled flue gas, so the flue gas is CO2-rich and needs only purification and compression.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _low intake; the boiler counterpart of kiln_oxy-fuel: capture is integral, so boiler_ccs-diffuse (post-combustion) does not fit; the CO2 compression unit is compressor_co2-dehydration

label: Recovery boiler
description: Burns concentrated black liquor, recovering smelt and raising high-pressure steam.

label: High-solids firing and high-pressure recovery boiler
description: Higher liquor dry solids and steam conditions, raising power and steam yield.
note: Type efficient variant -> alternative (Brad 2026-11-06, efficiency-variant ratio test): a different technology from its host, not an efficiency step on it, so it keeps its own absolute values.

label: Recovery boiler with post-combustion capture
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 422; row 501 gives 6 for post-combustion capture on biomass combustion
description: A recovery boiler whose stack gas is sent to capture. The CO2 is biogenic, so this is a removal rather than an avoided emission. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. The mill steam balance is what binds, and that is the host-side fact this row carries. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Solid-fuel boiler
description: Grate or fluidized-bed boiler firing solid fuels.

label: Flash calciner for clay
description: Dried, ground clay calcined in suspension at 800-900 degC to a metakaolin pozzolan.
note: Added 2026-10-27 (S121, Brad 2026-10-27: cement restructured into recipes and supplementary-material nodes). Fuel taken as natural gas (D21).

label: Electric alumina calciner
description: Calcines alumina hydrate with electric heating; no combustion emissions.
note: added 2026-10-02: different emissions kind from calciner_gas-suspension

label: Gas-suspension calciner
description: Suspension calcination of hydrate, at lower fuel use than a rotary calciner.
note: Absorbed calciner_hydrogen-fired (MT02, 2026-10-05); split back out 2026-10-14 (user, sanity-check NM014, D8), so hydrogen leaves the carriers. Type efficient variant -> conventional (Brad 2026-10-29): the standard modern alumina calciner; the rotary calciner it replaced is not in the database, so the end use had no conventional option.

label: Gas-suspension calciner with post-combustion capture

Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. Renamed from digester_bayer_ccs-diffuse (2026-10-05, naming review).

label: Hydrogen-fired alumina calciner
trl-basis: assessed (deloitte_2022_001, mpp_2023_001; Rio Tinto Yarwun demonstration)
description: Calcines alumina hydrate with hydrogen firing (air or oxy-fired), in a gas-suspension calciner retrofitted or built for hydrogen.

label: Electrified or indirectly heated calciner
description: Calcines the meal with electric heat or an indirectly heated vessel, separating process CO2 from flue gas.
note: Sends its separated process CO2 (about 0.50 t per t clinker) to industrial-minerals.service.ccs.concentrated for compression (option B, Brad 2026-11-05)

label: Advanced low-energy solvent
description: Second-generation solvents cutting reboiler duty against first-generation MEA.
note: Type efficient variant -> alternative (Brad 2026-11-06, efficiency-variant ratio test): a different technology from its host, not an efficiency step on it, so it keeps its own absolute values. Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Amine post-combustion capture
description: Absorbs CO2 from flue gas into an amine solvent; steam strips it back out.
examples-named: Boundary Dam (Cansolv); Entropy Glacier; Brevik cement; Solid sorbent capture; Calcium looping; Svante
note: TRL 9 in power, 7-8 on cement kilns. Merged capture-unit_calcium-looping (Calcium looping) 2026-10-02 [C36, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 7, product-unit t. Absorbed capture-unit_solid-sorbent (OG08, 2026-10-05). Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

note: Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Cryogenic separation
description: Condenses CO2 from a pressurized stream at low temperature.
note: Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Liquid-solvent DAC
description: Alkaline solution captures CO2; a high-temperature calciner regenerates it.
note: Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Solid-sorbent DAC
description: Sorbent beds cycled at low temperature, suited to waste heat and modular build.
examples-named: Climeworks; Deep Sky Alpha (Innisfail, Alberta, operating since August 2025)
note: Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Membrane or cryogenic post-combustion capture

label: Physical solvent
description: Selexol or Rectisol absorption at pressure on gasifier syngas.
note: Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

description: Casts liquid steel into slabs, blooms or billets in a continuous strand.

label: Strip casting

label: Absorption chiller
description: Heat-driven cycle using waste heat or steam instead of electricity.

label: High-efficiency chiller
description: Variable-speed or magnetic-bearing centrifugal machine, often on natural refrigerants.

Split 2026-10-28 (S164, Brad): the hvac cooling service moved to chiller_hvac (seasonal capacity factor); this archetype is process refrigeration, product cooling.

label: Washing and clean-in-place system

label: Hot rolling mill efficiency measures, moderate
description: Mill-side measures cutting rolling power and reheat losses.
examples-named: coil box; endless rolling; automatic gauge and flatness control; mill lubrication systems
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Ring rolling with variable wall thickness
description: Rolls rings with varying wall thickness close to final shape, cutting material and machining.
note: The hierarchy has no non-ferrous rolling node; linked to melting, casting and fabrication. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Thin-slab casting with direct rolling
description: Casts a thin slab and rolls it hot in line, cutting reheating and rolling passes.
note: Type efficient variant -> alternative (Brad 2026-11-06, efficiency-variant ratio test): a different technology from its host, not an efficiency step on it, so it keeps its own absolute values.

label: Aromatics (BTX) extraction plant
description: Solvent extraction and extractive distillation of benzene, toluene and xylenes from reformate or pyrolysis gasoline, with pygas hydrotreating and xylene fractionation.
note: Added 2026-10-23 (baselines 2026-10-23 (modeller: build the missing baselines)). Average-plant examples; best-practice plants are on the efficiency-moderate variant.

label: Aromatics extraction plant, best practice
description: The aromatics plant at best-practice energy use (heat integration across extraction and distillation).
note: Added 2026-10-23 (baselines 2026-10-23 (modeller: build the missing baselines)). Best-practice-technology examples (Saygin 2011, IEA 2013, Boulamanti 2017 energy integration).

label: Biogas upgrader (component)
description: Removes CO2 and impurities from biogas or landfill gas by water scrubbing, amine, pressure swing adsorption, membranes or organic solvent.
note: The upgrader alone; anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading is digester and upgrader together. Methane slip differs by technology (0.04% amine to 0.5-20% membrane). Added 2026-09-23. Made a component 2026-09-24: an upgrader delivers RNG only with a digester (anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading) or landfill gas (process-improvement_landfill-gas-recovery) behind it, so it serves no hierarchy node.

label: Clarification and sludge dewatering
description: Primary clarifiers with belt or screw presses, and dryers where the sludge is burnt.
note: product-unit t: most of its sources price it per t (its end use is measured in GJ). Product unit t -> m3 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Filtered or paste (dry-stack) tailings
description: Dewaters tailings mechanically, cutting pond volume and recycled-water heating.
note: Merged separator_paste-tailings (Paste and dry-stack tailings) 2026-09-23; it had family mining, type alternative, trl 9, product-unit GJ. Type efficient variant -> alternative (Brad 2026-11-06): it uses slightly more energy than the technology it replaces; its benefit is water recovery and safer tailings storage.

label: Gravity and magnetic separation
description: Density and magnetic separation for iron ore and heavy minerals, and dense-medium cyclones and jigs for coal washing.
note: Also the coal washing plant (node alignment review 2026-11-05 CM03): coal preparation by dense-medium separation at about 0.01-0.04 GJ/t in multi-Mt/yr plants.

label: Lignin extraction
description: Precipitates lignin from the liquor as a fuel or chemical feedstock, debottlenecking the boiler.
note: Type alternative -> reference 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (database/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): set aside: its numbers are per t lignin and a variant of the recovery boiler needs them per t black liquor solids (no ratio sourced yet).

label: Membrane bioreactor effluent treatment
description: Activated sludge with submerged membranes replacing the clarifier; about twice the energy of conventional activated sludge.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Mine water treatment plant
description: Lime treatment, settling and polishing before discharge.
note: Merged separator_reverse-osmosis (Reverse osmosis and evaporative concentration) 2026-10-02 [C20, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; split back out 2026-10-14 (user, sanity-check NM007, D8), so this is lime treatment only. product-unit m3 of water, not GJ: every example is per m3 (corrected 2026-10-02)

label: Naphthenic froth treatment
description: Naphtha diluent, inclined plate settlers and centrifuges or cyclones at 70-90 degC, with naphtha recovery from the tailings. Recovers about 98% of the bitumen but leaves 1-2% water and solids and all the asphaltenes, so the product goes to an upgrader.
note: Added 2026-10-23 (baselines 2026-10-23 (modeller: build the missing baselines)). The incumbent at Suncor base plant, Syncrude Mildred Lake and CNRL Horizon, which all feed on-site upgraders.

label: Non-aqueous extraction
description: Solvent-based extraction without hot water, cutting heat and tailings.
note: Node alignment 2026-11-05 (OS03): solvent recovery heat and solvent loss are requests (records/reference/service-request.csv), both judgements.

label: Sensor-based ore sorting
description: Rejects waste rock before milling, cutting the tonnes ground.

label: Paraffinic froth treatment
description: Paraffinic solvent rejects asphaltenes, giving a cleaner bitumen product.

label: Produced water recycling for makeup
description: Treats and reuses produced and flowback water as fracturing or steam makeup instead of disposing of it.
note: Cuts both disposal energy and freshwater draw. Product unit GJ -> m3 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Reduced emission completions
description: Portable sand traps, three-phase separators and dehydrators on a fractured well during flowback, sending the gas to sales instead of venting or flaring it.
note: Added 2026-10-03 for the Natural Gas STAR documents (Brad). Mapped to supply.well-tests, the CIMS node for completion and test flowback; whether that node is priced in t CH4 is on cims/to-fix.md. Product is t CH4 avoided per year (abated), as the CIMS model prices natural-gas.product.supply.venting.* (except controls) and supply.fugitive in t CH4; per t CH4 of service handled = per t avoided x the reduction share (modeller 2026-10-02). Product CH4 -> methane (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Reverse osmosis mine water treatment
description: Membrane desalination (reverse osmosis, or electrodialysis on brackish feed) where the discharge permit needs dissolved solids removed, at about ten times the energy per cubic metre of lime treatment.
note: Restored 2026-10-14 (user, sanity-check NM007, D8): separator_mine-water-treatment absorbed it 2026-10-02 (C20); the ETSAP I12 desalination examples moved back here. Serves no CIMS node, as its sibling (the tailings-disposal links were dropped 2026-10-09: those nodes are per t tailings).

label: Thickening, filtration and water reclaim (slurry tailings)
description: Thickens and filters concentrate and tailings and pumps the recovered process water back to the mill; the slurry-tailings baseline that dry-stack tailings compete with.
note: Product concentrate -> tailings (t) and merged separator_tailings-reclaim (Tailings thickening and water reclaim; family machine-drive, product shaft work GJ) node-split follow-up 2026-10-22 (B1 revised, modeller): the reclaim system is the equipment the pump drives power, not a drive, so it sits on tailings disposal with the dry-stack alternative. Examples printed per t ore milled are taken per t tailings (tailings are about 95-98% of ore by mass).

label: De-oiling and warm lime softening
description: Skim tanks, induced gas flotation and warm lime softening conditioning produced water for steam generation.
note: The water plant is part of what sets the steam-to-oil ratio. Product unit GJ -> m3 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Hydrotransport and warm-water extraction
description: Slurries ore in warm water, separating bitumen froth in gravity vessels.
note: Node alignment 2026-11-05 (OS03): the hot process water is a steam request (records/reference/service-request.csv); the source value is electricity only.

label: Shaft-furnace direct reduction
description: Reduces pellets in a shaft with reformed natural gas (or a natural-gas and hydrogen blend), giving solid DRI for an EAF. The about-100% hydrogen case is shaft-furnace_hydrogen-direct-reduction.
examples-named: MIDREX; Energiron; ArcelorMittal Contrecoeur; Dofasco Energiron ZR project (2.5 Mt/yr, announced); Fluidized-bed direct reduction
note: Merged reactor_fluidized-bed-direct-reduction (Fluidized-bed direct reduction) 2026-10-02 [C23, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 6, product-unit t. Hydrogen (about 100% H2) case split out to shaft-furnace_hydrogen-direct-reduction 2026-10-14 (D4, IS013); HYBRIT and Stegra moved with it.

label: Shaft-furnace direct reduction with capture
description: A gas-based DRI plant whose CO2 removal unit, which already strips CO2 from the recycled top gas, sends that nearly pure stream to capture instead of venting it. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. The reformer and heater flue gas is a separate, dilute stream. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Electrolytic-hydrogen direct reduction with EAF (whole plant)
description: Electrolysers, a hydrogen shaft furnace and an electric arc furnace together, per tonne of steel.
note: Whole-route alternative to shaft-furnace_direct-reduction plus electric-arc-furnace; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-25. Reference whole plant from 2026-11-05 (node alignment ST01, rule 3): the route reaches the model through electric-arc-furnace, shaft-furnace_hydrogen-direct-reduction and the hydrogen node; compared with that chain in output/chain-validation.csv (chain h2-dri-eaf).

label: Hydrogen direct reduction
description: Reduces iron ore pellets (or fines, in a fluidised bed) with about 100% hydrogen instead of reformed natural gas, giving solid DRI for an EAF; a little natural gas may be added for heat and carbon. Hydrogen production is not included; the whole route with electrolysers and EAF is shaft-furnace_electrolytic-hydrogen.
note: Split from shaft-furnace_direct-reduction 2026-10-14 (user decision D4, IS013): the about-100% hydrogen DRI examples moved here; the parent keeps the natural-gas case and the 30% hydrogen blend.

label: Sinter plant
description: Travelling-grate strand fusing ore fines, fluxes and coke breeze into sinter.
note: Renamed from sinter-plant_strand (2026-10-05, naming review).

label: Sinter plant efficiency measures, moderate
description: Charging, bed and sealing measures on an existing sinter strand.
examples-named: improved charging; increased bed depth; reduced air leakage; ignition-hood control
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Sinter plant efficiency measures, strong
description: Recirculating part of the waste gas and recovering cooler heat.
examples-named: waste-gas recirculation (EPOSINT, EOS); sinter-cooler exhaust gas heat recovery
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Tuyere-injected bath smelting reactor
description: Continuous bath smelting of sulphide concentrate with tuyere-injected oxygen-enriched air (Noranda, Teniente reactors).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave; Canadian stock

label: Oxygen bottom-blowing bath smelting
description: Bath smelting with oxygen blown through bottom tuyeres (SKS/BBS), largely autogenous.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: Flash smelting furnace
description: Oxygen-enriched flash smelting of sulphide concentrate, with a waste-heat boiler.

label: Smelting efficiency measures, moderate
description: Incremental measures on an existing smelter off-gas and feed system.
examples-named: feed drying with off-gas heat; improved hooding; oxygen control
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. Renamed from smelting-vessel_efficiency-moderate 2026-10-08 so the name carries its base archetype.

label: Smelting efficiency measures, strong
description: Higher oxygen enrichment with a waste-heat boiler on the off-gas.
examples-named: higher oxygen enrichment; waste-heat boiler on the off-gas; off-gas heat to feed drying
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. Renamed from smelting-vessel_efficiency-strong 2026-10-08 so the name carries its base archetype.

label: Low-shaft smelting reduction
description: A single low-shaft furnace smelting cold-bonded self-reducing pellets or briquettes with fine coal or biomass and a hot air blast, without coke ovens or sinter.
note: Not two-stage smelting reduction (Corex/Finex has a separate pre-reduction shaft and oxygen-blown melter-gasifier). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Coal-based smelting reduction
description: Smelting reduction on coal without coke ovens: pre-reduction shaft plus melter-gasifier (Corex, Finex) or single-vessel bath smelting (HIsarna).
sources: etsap_2010_002; CIMS; ukerc_2013_001; iea_2024_001; GEM HIsarna (web)
note: No Canadian stock. Merged smelting-vessel_bath-reduction (Bath smelting reduction) 2026-10-02 [C24, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 6, product-unit t. Renamed from smelting-vessel_two-stage (2026-10-05, naming review).

label: Coal-based smelting reduction with capture
description: A smelting reduction plant (two-stage or bath) whose CO2-rich off-gas is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
examples-named: COREX with CCS (ETSAP I02); Bath smelting reduction with capture
note: Split from the plant without capture: capture roughly doubles its cost. Merged smelting-vessel_bath-reduction_ccs-concentrated (Bath smelting reduction with capture) 2026-10-02 [C24, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 6, product-unit t. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. Renamed from smelting-vessel_two-stage_ccs-concentrated (2026-10-05, naming review).

label: Top-submerged-lance bath smelting
description: Bath smelting with a submerged lance, for concentrates and secondary feed.

label: Solar thermal (non-concentrating)
description: Flat-plate, evacuated-tube or compound-parabolic collectors raising hot water or low-pressure steam.
note: Merged solar-concentrator_thermal (Concentrating solar thermal) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 7-9. Merged solar-collector_bayer (Solar thermal in the Bayer process) 2026-10-02 [C14, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 6, product-unit t. Split by heat tier 2026-10-09 (modeller): parabolic-trough and linear-Fresnel examples moved to solar-concentrator_line-focus, solar-tower CST examples to solar-concentrator; low tier only.

label: Line-focus solar concentrator (parabolic trough, linear Fresnel)
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 536 (concentrating solar thermal, merged 2026-09-30, trl 7-9)
description: Parabolic-trough or linear-Fresnel collector fields raising steam or thermal oil at about 150-400 degC, often with storage.
examples-named: Solar thermal in the Bayer process
note: Split from solar-collector 2026-10-09 (modeller): concentrating line-focus examples and generic CST digestion-steam examples (medium tier). Tower and dish stay on solar-concentrator.

label: Point-focus solar concentrator (tower, dish)
description: Solar tower or dish concentrating to furnace temperatures.
note: Renamed from solar-concentrator_high-temperature (2026-10-05, naming review). Solar-tower CST examples moved here from solar-collector 2026-10-09 (heat-tier split). Renamed from solar-concentrator 2026-10-09 (modeller): parallel archetypes both carry a discriminator; a bare name is kept for a base with variants.

label: Catalytic cracking of naphtha
description: Catalysis lowers the cracking temperature against a thermal cracker.

label: Electrified cracker furnace
description: Electric heating of the cracking coils in place of burners.
examples-named: BASF, SABIC and Linde demonstration at Ludwigshafen (4 t/h, 6 MW, 2024); Rotodynamic cracking reactor
note: Merged steam-cracker_rotodynamic (Rotodynamic cracking reactor) 2026-10-02 [C25, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 6, product-unit t.

label: Fired tubular steam cracker
carriers: oil; coal; methanol; biomass; steam; hydrogen; natural-gas; naphtha; ethane; electricity
description: Hydrocarbon feed cracked in fired tubular coils, then quenched and separated; per t of high-value chemicals. Represents an ethane cracker, the Canadian fleet's feed (ruling 2026-10-14): examples that do not state a feed are put on t HVC with the ethane ratio; naphtha, LPG and gas-oil examples are kept, each on t HVC with its own feed's ratio (records/reference/feedstock.csv).

label: Steam cracker with capture on the furnace flue gas
description: A steam cracker whose cracking-furnace flue gas, from numerous dilute stacks, is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Oxy-fuel cracking (iea_2024_001 row 226, TRL 5) concentrates it instead. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. Renamed from steam-cracker_ccs-diffuse 2026-10-08 so the name carries its base archetype.

label: Steam cracker efficiency measures, moderate
carriers: oil; coal; methanol; biomass; steam; hydrogen; natural-gas; naphtha; electricity
description: The fired tubular steam cracker with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: dividing-wall debutanizer/depropanizer; hybrid membrane-distillation for ethylene/ethane and butadiene separation (UKERC CH-SC1 to CH-SC3)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on steam-cracker_fired-tubular.

label: Fired tubular steam cracker on hydrogen fuel
description: A conventional steam cracker whose furnaces burn hydrogen (its own off-gas plus imported hydrogen) instead of fuel gas.
note: Variant of steam-cracker_fired-tubular (S149, Brad 2026-10-27): the MIDDEN cards TC0265, TC0410, TC0433, set aside from the host in the 2026-10-24 run, moved here; their incremental capex adds to the host's.

label: Steam reforming with Haber-Bosch synthesis
description: Reformed natural gas feeds ammonia synthesis at pressure.

label: Ammonia plant with capture on the process CO2
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 347 (partial capture); row 346 gives 6 for full capture
description: An ammonia plant whose CO2 removal step ahead of synthesis sends its pure process CO2 to capture instead of venting it; part of that CO2 is already sold for urea. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. This is the cheapest capture in the sector and should not be averaged with flue-gas capture. Full capture needs a second, dilute plant on the reformer flue gas. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Steam-reforming ammonia plant efficiency measures, moderate
description: Moderate efficiency measures on the steam-reforming ammonia plant (reformer revamps, heat recovery).
note: added 2026-10-05 (archetype combination review 2026-10-03)

label: Ammonia plant efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice reforming, synthesis and heat integration in an ammonia plant, saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state of the art 46% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Steam methane reformer
description: Reforms natural gas with steam, then shifts to hydrogen and CO2.

label: Steam methane reformer with capture on the shift gas
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 285 (partial capture); row 284 gives 6 for high capture rates
description: A steam methane reformer whose shifted syngas, where the CO2 is already at high partial pressure, is sent to capture. Taking the reformer flue gas as well would also need the diffuse capture service. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: [refinery-hydrogen] Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. Partial capture takes only the shift gas and reaches about 60% of the plant total; full capture adds a diffuse-stream plant on the reformer flue gas. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Steam methane reformer with capture on the flue gas
trl-basis: assessed (post-combustion amine on reformer flue gas; ieaghg_2017_001, ieaghg_2017_002)
description: A steam methane reformer whose reformer-furnace flue gas (diluted CO2) is sent to post-combustion capture; holds the host plant only, the capture plant is capture-unit_amine.
examples-named: IEAGHG 2017-02 case 3; ReCAP SMR flue gas
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake (two sources)

label: Steam methane reformer efficiency measures, moderate
description: Heat integration and feed conditioning on an existing reformer.
examples-named: pre-reforming; convection-section heat recovery; combustion-air preheat; hydrogen recovery from purge gas
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. product-unit t: most of its sources price it per t (its end use is measured in GJ). Renamed from steam-reformer_efficiency-moderate (2026-10-05, naming review).

label: Natural-gas reforming and methanol synthesis (whole plant)
description: Reformed gas converted to methanol over a copper catalyst.
note: Renamed from reactor_syngas-methanol (2026-10-05, naming review).

label: Back-pressure or extraction steam-turbine CHP
carriers: biomass; coal; municipal-waste; steam; natural-gas; oil; black-liquor; by-product-gas
description: Boiler raises high-pressure steam; the turbine passes it to process at lower pressure.
note: [heat-low-temp] CHP: the heat is the service and the electricity a co-product (design doc D1). Moved off the retired chp end use, 2026-09-14.

label: Back-pressure steam-turbine CHP with post-combustion capture
carriers: biomass; black-liquor; coal; municipal-waste; natural-gas; oil; by-product-gas; electricity; steam
trl-basis: assessed: biomass CHP capture demonstrations (Stockholm Exergi, Fortum Oslo pilot)
description: A solid-fuel boiler and back-pressure turbine CHP whose flue gas is sent to capture. Regeneration steam is drawn from the unit itself, a host-side penalty that belongs here and cuts its electricity export. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Added 2026-11-04 (user, to-process intake NEW proposal). Biomass firing makes it a removal (BECCS). Host steam-turbine_back-pressure.

label: Condensing steam turbine
description: Boiler and condensing turbine producing power only.
examples-named: steelworks power plants firing coke-oven gas
note: Carriers biomass; steam; coal; oil; natural-gas; by-product-gas -> steam 2026-10-28 (HPCH010, Brad): the archetype is the turbine only; the boiler and its fuel are another archetype.

label: Steam turbine drive
description: Back-pressure turbine driving a large compressor or pump.

label: Waste-heat power (ORC or steam Rankine)
description: Converts exhaust or process heat to electricity.
examples-named: ORC on kiln and compressor exhaust
note: Absorbed heat-recovery-unit_compressor-station-power (OG13, 2026-10-05).

label: Underground hydrogen storage (salt or lined rock cavern)
description: Compressed hydrogen stored in a solution-mined salt cavern or a lined rock cavern.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave Product unit t -> GJ 2026-10-09 (product-unit review). Type -> reference (node alignment review 2026-11-05 HY03, 2026-11-05): storage does not deliver hydrogen; off the distribution node, kept as a reference archetype.

label: Electric thermal energy storage
description: Electrically charged solid or salt store discharging steam, decoupling heat from power prices.
examples-named: Rondo (100 MWh, >100 bar steam, California, October 2025); Kraftblock; Antora; Rondo

label: Heat-charged thermal storage
description: Economizers and heat exchangers recovering heat from flue gas or process streams, and sensible or latent stores charged with that heat and discharged to a heat demand.
note: Storage costs are add-on (incremental) costs, pooled only with a base system cost from the same source. Added 2026-09-26. Merged heat-recovery-unit (Waste-heat recovery unit) 2026-09-30; it had type conventional, trl 9. Medium tier removed 2026-10-09 (modeller): reported delivery temperatures stay below 150 degC.

label: Acid-catalyzed transesterification
description: Homogeneous acid catalyst tolerates free fatty acids in waste oils but needs a large methanol excess and recovery duty.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake Product unit t -> GJ 2026-10-09: final product in energy, as the CIMS biofuels node (GJ).

label: Alkali-catalyzed transesterification
description: Reacts oils or fats with methanol over a homogeneous catalyst to fatty acid methyl esters.
note: Product unit t -> GJ 2026-10-09: final product in energy, as the CIMS biofuels node (GJ).

label: Heterogeneous-catalyst transesterification
description: Solid catalyst avoids the washing and neutralization steps and gives cleaner glycerin.
note: Product unit t -> GJ 2026-10-09: final product in energy, as the CIMS biofuels node (GJ).

label: Supercritical-methanol transesterification
description: Non-catalytic transesterification in supercritical methanol (about 350 degC).
note: added 2026-10-02 from the _high intake Product unit t -> GJ 2026-10-09: final product in energy, as the CIMS biofuels node (GJ).

label: Turboexpander NGL recovery
description: Expansion refrigeration recovering ethane and heavier liquids.
note: PRODUCT UNIT 1000-m3 (a thousand cubic metres; the regulators print it as e3m3; user 2026-10-23).

label: Turboexpander at pressure let-down
description: Recovers pressure energy as power instead of throttling, with line heating.
note: Family oil-and-gas -> power-generation 2026-10-09: classified by its primary product (electricity), as the other power-generation archetypes. Shown in the natural gas transmission and distribution end use per 1000 m3 of gas let down, beside the conventional valve_pressure-let-down (Brad 2026-10-29).

label: Infrared or ultraviolet curing
description: Radiant or photochemical curing in place of hot-air ovens.

label: Pressure-regulating valve with line heater
description: Throttles pipeline gas to distribution pressure at a city-gate or regulator station, with a gas-fired water-bath heater offsetting the Joule-Thomson cooling; the baseline that the let-down turboexpander competes with.
note: Added 2026-10-29 (Brad 2026-10-29): the conventional option for natural gas transmission and distribution. No source characterises it as a technology, so its values are judgements (records/fill/fill-judgement.csv).

label: Mechanical vapour recompression evaporation
description: Recompresses vapour to drive the evaporator, replacing most live steam with electricity.
examples-named: Caustic evaporation with mechanical vapour recompression
note: Type efficient variant -> alternative (Brad 2026-11-06, efficiency-variant ratio test): a different technology from its host, not an efficiency step on it, so it keeps its own absolute values. Merged vapour-recompressor_caustic-evaporation (Caustic evaporation with mechanical vapour recompression) 2026-10-02 [C12, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 9, product-unit t. PRODUCT BASIS (user 2026-10-14, D17, PB019): t of WATER EVAPORATED, so one basis serves the black-liquor and caustic-soda nodes; per-t-product examples convert with a water-evaporated ratio (MIDDEN caustic soda: cf-water-per-caustic-midden).

label: CO2 injection and geological storage
description: Injection of CO2 into deep saline formations, depleted fields or oil fields (EOR), with monitoring.
note: Complement to pipeline_co2 at the transmission nodes; not an alternative to it. Added 2026-09-25. Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Cyclic steam stimulation (CSS)
description: One well alternately injects steam, soaks and produces heated bitumen. The wells, pads and central processing facility; the steam is bought from the crude-oil steam service.
note: As well_sagd; the steam-to-oil ratio is typically higher (ETSAP P02: 3.4 against 3.2). Sources abbreviate it CSS and ETSAP P02 misprints it 'CCS'. Added 2026-09-23. Node alignment 2026-11-05 (OS01, rule 1): generator fuel restated as a steam request at 80% (records/reference/supplied-heat.csv).

label: Disposal well injection
description: Pumps produced and flowback water to a disposal formation.
note: Product unit GJ -> m3 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Electromagnetic (radio-frequency) heating with solvent
description: In-situ bitumen recovery heating the reservoir with radio-frequency antennae and a solvent instead of steam.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave

label: In-situ oxy-combustion steam generation
description: Steam generated downhole by oxy-fuel combustion, with the combustion CO2 left in the reservoir.
note: added 2026-10-02 from the second intake wave Absorbed boiler_direct-contact (OG14, 2026-10-05). Carriers + electricity 2026-10-28 (OG015): the air separation unit.

label: Steam-assisted gravity drainage (SAGD)
description: Paired horizontal wells: steam injected in the upper well drains heated bitumen to the lower producer. The wells, pads and central processing facility; the steam is bought from the crude-oil steam service.
note: Whole-process archetype for in-situ recovery; boiler_once-through and boiler_direct-contact are the steam-generation equipment within it, so do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23. Merged boiler_once-through (Once-through field boiler) 2026-10-02 [C38, database/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type conventional, trl 9, product-unit m3. Node alignment 2026-11-05 (OS01, rule 1): the once-through steam generators are no longer inside the archetype; the sources' generator fuel is restated as a steam request at 80% efficiency and the OTSG share of capital (about 9%, CERI 2017 Table A.1) taken off (records/reference/supplied-heat.csv).

label: Solvent-assisted steam recovery
description: Co-injects a solvent with steam, cutting the steam-to-oil ratio. The steam is bought from the crude-oil steam service; solvent lost in the reservoir is a request for butane.
note: Node alignment 2026-11-05 (OS01, OS02): generator fuel restated as a steam request at 80%; solvent make-up in records/reference/service-request.csv.

label: Solvent-only extraction
description: Dissolves bitumen with solvent and little or no steam.

label: Wind turbines at site
description: Site wind generation, usually with storage, at remote operations.

label: Kraft pulp mill (whole mill)
description: Whole kraft pulp mill per air-dry tonne: wood handling, cooking, washing, bleaching, chemical recovery, and the mill's own boilers. Reference only: the hierarchy keeps the step chain (pulping, bleaching, drying, evaporator, recovery furnace, lime kiln, steam).
note: Added 2026-11-05 (node alignment review PP04, rule 3, Brad 2026-11-05): holds the whole-mill figures (ETSAP I07 Table 4 kraft sections, IEA 2009 Table 5.1 and 5.5) that were ruled out on, or left off, the unit archetypes. Validated against the chain in output/chain-validation.csv.

label: Paper machine with dryer section (whole papermaking)
description: Whole papermaking per tonne of paper: forming, pressing, and drying. Reference only: the hierarchy splits papermaking into the forming node (paper-machine) and the drying node (dryer_steam-heated).
note: Added 2026-11-05 (node alignment review PP04, rule 3, Brad 2026-11-05): holds whole-papermaking figures (ETSAP I07 Table 4 paper-making, IEA 2009 Table 5.1 BAT by grade, IEA 2009 Table 5.5 stand-alone mill cost) that were ruled out on, or left off, paper-machine. Grades are pooled. Validated against paper-machine plus dryer_steam-heated in output/chain-validation.csv.

label: Black liquor gasification to motor fuels (whole plant)
trl-basis: assessed (Chemrec DP-1 at Pitea and Domsjo design, pilot and design studies only)
description: Black liquor gasification whose syngas makes DME, methanol, FT liquids, or mixed alcohols, with make-up biomass to replace the steam and power the recovery boiler no longer raises. Reference only: CIMS has no outlet for the fuel products at the recovery furnace node.
note: Added 2026-11-05 (node alignment review PP16, rule 3, Brad 2026-11-05): the fuel-product examples moved off gasifier_black-liquor, which keeps the combined-cycle (power) route.

label: Gypsum calciner (kettle or flash)
description: Kettle, rotary or flash calciner driving off three quarters of the water of hydration to make stucco (beta hemihydrate) at about 150-180 degC.
note: Added 2026-11-05 (node alignment review 2026-11-05 IM12, Brad 2026-11-05: judgement values; the mineral dryer at 0.23 GJ/t understated calcining). No held source gives a gypsum calciner.

label: Electric paper dryer
description: Electrically heated dryer section (electric infrared or resistance-heated cylinders and hood air) replacing steam; the water still needs its latent heat, so energy use is near the steam section's useful heat.
note: Added 2026-11-05 (node alignment review 2026-11-05 PP02, Brad 2026-11-05: build a judgement electric paper dryer). Replaces dryer_electric on the paper drying nodes; dryer_electric (MIDDEN rotary-drum cards, 0.22 GJ/t) is for low-moisture bulk solids.

label: SF6 cover gas (no abatement)
description: Molten magnesium is blanketed with dilute SF6, all of which is released: the zero-cost option an SF6-free cover gas competes with.
note: Added 2026-11-06 (node alignment NF25, Brad 2026-11-06): SF6 is a casting emission, so it moves from the cells and retorts to the magnesium cover-gas node, which the producers ask for the SF6 they would use; every value is a judgement.

label: SF6-free magnesium cover gas
description: Sulphur dioxide or a fluorinated ketone (GWP about 1) in dry air, or dilute HFC-134a, protects the melt in place of SF6, with a gas-mixing and metering system at each casting station.
note: Added 2026-11-06 (node alignment NF25, Brad 2026-11-06): SF6 is a casting emission, so it moves from the cells and retorts to the magnesium cover-gas node, which the producers ask for the SF6 they would use; every value is a judgement.
